title: Resolve text assignments into a printable scene
description: Implement a pure layout operation that resolves a validated text template, physical label dimensions, and a valid position assignment into the authoritative framework-neutral `PrintableScene`.
acceptanceCriteria: Scene generation accepts only validated template, exact validated layout revision, and valid assignment values
The scene uses the documented millimetre coordinate system and contains physical bounds, text runs, diagnostics, and stable position metadata
Equivalent normalized inputs produce structurally equivalent scenes
Missing templates, invalid assignments, unsupported nodes, and layout failures return structured diagnostics
The pure operation imports no React, DOM, IndexedDB, SVG-renderer, or PDF APIs
The derived scene is not persisted as authoring truth

steps.details: Create versioned framework-neutral scene, text-run, physical-bound, position-metadata, and diagnostic types using finite millimetre coordinates.
Create a narrow validated input contract containing resolved template, bundled font metrics, exact label boundary/content region, and assignment metadata.
Lay out constrained text into deterministic runs and bounds, preserving stable ordering and returning diagnostics rather than partial exceptions for expected failures.
Resolve project references and assignments before invoking layout, then expose the resulting scene or named refusal to presentation adapters.
Assert fixed scene output for a canonical fixture, equivalent output for equivalent normalized inputs, and structured diagnostics for each invalid dependency.

technicalNotes: The printable scene is the single layout authority shared by preview and PDF.
Font metrics must come from the same bundled font resources later used by the PDF renderer.
